cohort: The study included all patients who underwent emergency hysterectomy following vaginal or cesarean delivery at the Fatemieh Medical and Educational Center between 2009 and 2022.
finding: The incidence of emergency hysterectomy increased from 0.34/1000 to 0.71/1000 deliveries over 14 years, with a history of CS and placenta accreta previa significantly increasing the hysterectomy rate.
mod_finding: A history of cesarean section significantly increased the mean rate of emergency hysterectomy following delivery.
